Village bagels and lox.d: Toasted, cream cheese spread thick, smoked salmon, capers, sliced red onion and sprigs of fresh dill.

Deli pastrami on rye.d: Steamed soft, sliced and piled high on the bread. Brown deli mustard and a sour pickle alongside.
Deli pastrami on rye.note: The sector car gets it on the arm. Frank pays.

Deli hero, paid for.d: Steamed pastrami in a long roll with Swiss cheese, slaw and Russian dressing, horseradish and pickle.

Black and white cookies.d: Soft sour cream cake cookie, the flat side iced half in vanilla fondant and half in chocolate.
Black and white cookies.note: Fresh Tues. and Fri. Two for Frank and Leslie.

Village vanilla iced coffee, paid for.d: Steeped overnight in the icebox, vanilla syrup, milk and ice, a ball of ice cream floating on top.
